spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_btc_eth
spec.hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance predicts 15-min forward returns in BTCUSD/ETHUSD; liquid majors avoid the tail-liquidity execution costs that killed sprint32/34.
spec.power_argument: entry_per_day_cap=6 x 2 symbols x ~30-day window >= 360 trades (>=300 target). Assuming ~15bps 15-min return stdev for majors (unconfirmed, needs historical check before run), MDE at n=360, alpha=0.05 ~= 1.9bps -- must exceed T1 round-trip cost to be actionable.
